title: Timing
description: The timing values two or more parties must agree on, each in seconds. The rules BETWEEN them (a parked probe fits twice in the boot hold; a model outlives a node TTL and a beat; the last-known record dies before the master forgets its nodes) are checked by grid-protocol's own tests, because JSON Schema cannot relate two values. Several are also operator knobs on the side that owns them (named in each description); the value here is the default the others were built against.

heartbeat_interval_seconds.description: How often a provider beats (public CLI `relay.HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL`).

node_ttl_seconds.description: A node silent this long is not selected (grid-src `NODE_TTL_SECONDS`, a knob; the heartbeat answer's `ttl_seconds`).

poll_window_seconds.description: How long a poll is held before its 204 (grid-src `poll_timeout_seconds`); a provider's own poll timeout must be longer.

asleep_probe_seconds.description: A provider parked on grid_asleep probes this often (public CLI `serve._ASLEEP_PROBE_SECONDS`).

stopped_probe_seconds.description: A provider parked on grid_stopped probes this often: only the owner's start ends it.

after_a_failed_beat_seconds.description: The next beat after a failed one (the platform's restart of a dead master).

boot_hold_seconds.description: Inside the boot-hold window a request that finds NO provider is held this long for one to beat (grid-src `GRID_BOOT_HOLD_SECONDS`, a knob). A woken master starts with every provider past its TTL.

boot_hold_window_seconds.description: How long after a master starts its boot hold applies (grid-src `GRID_BOOT_HOLD_WINDOW_SECONDS`, a knob).

model_retention_seconds.description: A model is dropped from a reader's list only after this long absent across two or more awake reads (a node TTL and a beat), so a cold wake does not blank a list (harness `GRID_MODEL_RETENTION_SECONDS|_MS`).

sleep_record_min_uptime_seconds.description: The last-known record is captured only from a master up this long: a node TTL and a beat, with a margin (grid-apis `sleep_record.MIN_UPTIME_SECONDS`).

access_loss_settle_seconds.description: No record is written until this long after somebody lost access to the grid: their machine can stay listed for a TTL and a beat (grid-apis `sleep_record.ACCESS_LOSS_SETTLE_SECONDS`).

last_known_max_age_seconds.description: 29 days: a last-known record older than this is not sent, and a reader ignores one (grid-apis `sleep_record.MAX_AGE_SECONDS`; harness `GRID_LAST_KNOWN_MAX_AGE_SECONDS|_MS`).

master_node_prune_seconds.description: 30 days: a master forgets a node row silent this long (grid-src `registry.prune_stale_nodes`).
